title: fix(extension): attach, auto-save notice and autofill summary polish
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. All predate 0.157.0.

- **Base-résumé filename has placeholder text.** Attaching the base résumé from the side panel names the file `Jane-Doe-Role-Company-resume.pdf`. `document_export.rs`'s `Source::Document` branch passes no job title or company, so `generate_filename` falls back to "Role" and "Company". Pass the tab's job title and company, or drop the placeholders.
- **Auto-save notice shows on other jobs' tabs.** "Saved 1 answer from this submit (Full-Stac…)" appears on a different job's tab. `lib/auto-save-notice.ts` keeps one global one-shot notice in `storage.session`. Store the tab or URL with it and show it only there.
- **Autofill summary doesn't count skipped fields.** It says "Filled 5 fields" but not how many ambiguous fields it skipped. `resolveFillResponse` ignores `skippedAmbiguous`. Add the count.
- **Fit score appears with no résumé.** An import reported "2% fit" before any résumé was uploaded. `resolve_resume` scores against any stored document, because documents have no kind. Skip scoring when the résumé text is blank.

title: fix(desktop): small behaviour gaps found in the pre-release e2e round
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. All predate 0.157.0.

- **Résumé upload doesn't seed the contact profile name or LinkedIn.** Email and phone are seeded, but not the full name or LinkedIn.
  - `commands/documents.rs` never copies `structured.name`, and `ContactProfile::fill_empty_from` has no full-name slot.
  - A plain-text `linkedin.com/in/...` without a scheme isn't linkified (`classify_contact_links` needs `http(s)://`).
- **Model picker lists embedding-only models as chat models.** `nomic-embed-text` and `qwen3-embedding:4b` appear as chat options. `ModelSelector` passes the Ollama list unfiltered. The backend's `is_embedding_only_model` already exists.
- **A failed résumé run shows no inline reason.**
  - After a timeout, the tailoring wizard drops back to the Model step with no inline error, only a generic "Résumé run failed" notification. The Staged-runs dialog does show the reason.
  - `use-resume-pipeline-session` `handleJobEvent` can drop `job.failed` when the record poll flips the run to failed first, so `gen.error` stays null.
- **Applications row keeps an "Applied" label after demotion.** Moving Saved → Screening → Saved leaves "Applied 1m ago" on the row. `applied_at` is never cleared on demotion, by design as the audit stamp, but `ApplicationRow` shows it regardless of status. Show the label only for statuses after apply.
- **Imported job text contains literal `\n`.** An extension-imported Spotify (Lever) job's Brief tab shows literal `\n` sequences. The likely cause is a JSON-LD or `__NEXT_DATA__` description with double-escaped newlines passed through `html_to_markdown` without unescaping (`scrape_url/html_fallback.rs`).

title: fix(desktop): copy and i18n polish found in the pre-release e2e round
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. All predate 0.157.0.

- **Pairing path copy is wrong.** The onboarding `extension.pairHint` and two help answers say to pair the extension in "Settings → Accounts". Since #1213, "Browser extension" is its own Settings section.
- **German sidebar greeting isn't localized.** `lib/greeting/greeting.ts` hard-codes "Good morning/afternoon/evening" in English.
- **German copy mixes "Sie" and "du".** `de/translation.json` has about 235 Sie/Ihr forms and about 52 du/dein forms. Pick one register.
- **AI Generate job-ad placeholder is wrong.** The job-ad textarea shows "Generated output will appear here" (`LeftPanel` reuses `aiGenerate.placeholder`). It needs its own key.
- **Resume Builder step counter appears twice.** It shows "STEP n OF 7" both in `WizardStep` and in `BuilderWizard`. Remove one.
- **Autopilot wizard location text is doubled.** It reads "from location settings from location settings" because `PrefilledBadge` renders the label and `StepTarget` passes the same string as `field`.
- **Autopilot title-cases user text.** The CSS `capitalize` class is applied to user text and ids: "E2E A3 Remote Android", "Remoteok", "Once A Day". Use display-name maps for board and schedule values, and drop `capitalize` on user text.

title: fix(desktop): settings search doesn't scroll to some anchors and leaves a stale nav highlight
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. This predates 0.157.0.

1. **No scroll for "embeddings".** Settings search → "embeddings" → click the result. It opens the AI section but stays at the top; it doesn't scroll to the `data-settings-anchor="ai-embeddings"` card. "AI spend", "Company research" and "Output tone" scroll correctly.
   - Probable cause: `SettingsContent` uses one `requestAnimationFrame` plus `scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })`. The embeddings card sits right under the tall stage-overrides card, so it is partly in view and `nearest` scrolls about 0. Async content above it can also shift the layout after that single frame.
   - Fix: use `block: 'start'` and re-check after layout settles.
2. **Stale nav highlight.** After a search-result click, the "General" nav item keeps a highlighted background while the real section is also marked active, so two items look selected. This may be a `:hover` left over after the remount under the cursor. Check that it clears when the pointer moves.

title: fix(desktop): monitoring shows the wrong model, raw job kinds, and counts cancelled jobs as failed
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. All predate 0.157.0.

1. **Wrong model in the header chip.** With the active model `qwen3.8:latest`, the chip reads "Ollama · qwen3.8-4090:latest".
   - Cause: `MonitoringPage` renders `health.ai.model` under a fixed "Ollama" label, and `reachable_model()` (`ollama/models.rs`) returns the first non-embedding entry of `/api/tags`, not the configured model.
   - `commands/system` also reports the scope as `localOllama` even when the active provider is in the cloud.
   - Fix: report the active provider and model from config, or label the chip as the local Ollama probe.
2. **Raw job kinds in the activity feed.** Rows show `pipeline.generate` and `ai.indexStale`. `hooks/use-kind-label-map.ts` has no entry for them, and the feed falls back to the raw kind.
3. **Cancelled counted as failed.** `useJobMetrics` counts `failed || cancelled` as Failed. A user stopping a help-chat answer lowers the success rate. Count cancelled separately.

title: fix(desktop): dashboard checklist keeps saying "add your résumé" until reload after the onboarding upload
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. This predates 0.157.0.

## Repro
1. Fresh profile.
2. Upload a résumé during onboarding and finish onboarding.

The Dashboard next-step tile says "1 of 3 done / Add your résumé" while Settings → Resume already lists the résumé. Navigating around doesn't clear it; it only updates after a window reload.

## Cause
- `NextStepTile` derives `hasResume` from `useEmbeddingStatus().documents.total` (query key `keys.ai.embeddingStatus`).
- A successful import only invalidates `keys.documents.all` (`services/use-documents`).
- `embeddingStatus` is invalidated only on embedding-config change, reembed completion or auto-index. Auto-index returns early during onboarding because no embedding model is configured yet.
- The root layout keeps the query mounted, so it never refetches.

## Fix
Also invalidate `keys.ai.embeddingStatus` in `useImportDocument` and `useRemoveDocument` `onSuccess`.

title: fix(desktop): jobs list keyboard and layout polish (enter acts on the wrong row, row overflow, duplicate cluster chips)
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. All predate 0.157.0.

1. **Enter acts on the wrong row.**
   - Repro: click row 1, press ArrowDown twice (selection moves to row 3 via `aria-activedescendant`), then press Enter. Row 1 is re-activated.
   - Cause: `PostingListItem` handles Enter in a per-row `onKeyDown`, and the clicked row keeps DOM focus.
   - Fix: handle Enter on the listbox container, using the active descendant.
   - Home/End only scroll without moving the selection.
2. **Row overflow.** In split view, rows that carry "viewed" or "Also on" labels clip ("· 2h ago vi…") and get a horizontal scrollbar. Only the company name truncates; location, time, chips and the viewed label are `shrink-0`.
3. **Duplicate cluster chips.** A cluster whose members all come from one board renders N identical "aggregator" chips in "Also on" (`components/job/ClusterSourceChips`), plus N identical rows in "All sources". Deduplicate by board, or show a count.

title: fix(desktop): a committed job search loses its results after navigating away, and the empty state says there are no postings
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. This predates 0.157.0.

## Repro
1. On Jobs, type "backend developer payments" and click Search. It shows "1 of 159".
2. Go to Applications, then come back to Jobs.

The board shows "0 / 159 jobs shown" with the "Search: …" chip still active. The empty state reads "No postings yet. Start a scrape to populate this board." A broad search such as "engineer" survives, but only because it happens to match as a substring.

## Cause
- The committed-search state lives in `usePostingsSearch` (`useMachine`/`useState`), which is local to the page, so it resets when the page remounts.
- The filter text lives in the session store, so the chip persists.
- On return, `isCommittedSearchActive` is false and the plain substring filter runs on the whole query.
- `JobsResults/EmptyResults.tsx` renders `t('jobs.empty')` unconditionally, even when `genuinelyEmpty` is false.

## Fix
- Lift the committed-search state into the session store, or clear the filter text when the page unmounts.
- When postings exist but none match, show filter-specific empty copy.

title: fix(desktop): referral modal hides its delete confirm, never shows saved drafts, and shows raw stream errors
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. All three predate 0.157.0.

1. **The delete confirm is hidden (MEDIUM).** Clicking the trash icon on a saved contact mounts "Delete this referral?" at z-600. The referral modal sits at z-650, so the confirm and its backdrop render behind it and can't be clicked.
   - Cause: `packages/ui` `ConfirmModal` hard-codes `zIndex={600}` and has no `zIndex` prop. `ReferralModal` uses 650.
   - Fix: add a `zIndex` prop to `ConfirmModal` and pass a higher layer from `ReferralList`. Check other confirms opened from inside modals too.
2. **Saved drafts are never shown.** A saved contact card shows only `c.notes`. The draft is saved (the upsert re-sends `messageDraft` / `emailDraft` / `inviteNoteDraft`) but never displayed, so a saved message can't be reviewed.
3. **Raw stream error.** A stalled stream shows "Stream error: error decoding response body" verbatim in the modal. The text is `AppError::Network(format!("Stream error: {e}"))` in `commands/ai_provider/stream.rs`, rendered by `useReferralDraft` as-is. Map it to a localized message.

title: fix(extension): an ashby import can report "couldn't read the description" after saving the full description
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. This predates 0.157.0; the partial flag dates from #1256.

## Repro
Import `https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ashby/7458d4e9-da2e-47bd-98cb-adfda43d42b2` from the popup.

The popup says "Imported … – couldn't read the description. Open AI Job Hunter → Applications to paste it.", yet the application holds a 20k-character description that looks correct. The fit score is also dropped from the message. Another Ashby posting imported cleanly.

## Cause (probable)
- `job-tools/responses.ts` shows that line only when `result.partial` is set.
- The desktop sets `partial` on the stub path, or when `embeds_ats_board(h, effective_url)` sees a cross-host ATS `<iframe>`.
- `ats_ref::ashby_slug` accepts any `*.ashbyhq.com`, so a frame on the posting can trip the flag even when the page itself yielded the description.

## Fix
- Don't flag a page as partial when it yielded a JSON-LD JobPosting or a usable description.
- Ignore frames whose slug equals the page's own slug.

title: fix(scraping): direct greenhouse imports store the hostname as the company
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. This predates 0.157.0; #1239 fixed the LinkedIn shape of the same fallback, but not this one.

## Repro
1. Open a posting on `https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/<company>/jobs/<id>` (for example `/anthropic/jobs/5186067008`).
2. Import it from the extension popup.

The application is stored with `company = "job-boards.greenhouse.io"` and `board = "url"`. Title and description are correct. Lever and Ashby imports are fine.

## Cause
- A direct-page import takes the DOM branch in `extension_bridge/import_flow.rs` (`scrape_url::parse_from_html`). The board resolvers (`try_greenhouse`) only run when the DOM parse is unusable.
- The React-rendered `job-boards.` page has no JSON-LD and no `og:site_name`, so `scrape_url/html_fallback.rs` falls back to `parse_generic_company(html).unwrap_or(host)` and the host is stored as the company.
- `ats_ref::greenhouse_slug` already recognises `job-boards.greenhouse.io`.

## Fix
In the HTML branch, when `ats_ref::extract_ats_ref(url)` matches, take the company from the board slug, or try the board API first.

title: fix(desktop): job-less résumé builds and ai generations create an "Untitled · Applied" application
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. This behaviour predates 0.157.0.

## Repro
- **Resume Builder:** finish the wizard with no job and click **Build résumé**. Applications now shows a company-less row "Untitled · Applied · Just now".
- **AI Generate:** generate with no job URL. You get the same kind of row.

## Cause
- `useResumeBuilder.ts` calls `saveAiGeneration` with no `jobUrl`. Its comment says the intent is "a fresh row", meaning a Documents entry only.
- `commands/ai_generations.rs` always calls `apps.upsert_for_origin(&job_url, …, ApplicationOrigin::Generate, …)`.
- `applications/writes.rs` gives the Generate origin `applied_at = now`, so the new row's status is `applied`.
- `row_by_job_url_conn` returns `None` for an empty URL. So every job-less save creates a new Application and never merges into an existing one.

## Fix
Skip the Application upsert in `ai_generations_save` when `job_url` is empty. The generation still appears in Documents.

title: fix(desktop): the cover-letter preview collapses under the letter-layout picker at normal window heights
body:
Found in the 0.157.0 pre-release E2E round. This bug predates 0.157.0: the layout is unchanged since the picker landed in #594/#988.

## Repro
1. Window at 1280×830.
2. AI Generate → paste a job ad → Cover letter → Generate.

The six full-width cards of the "Letter layout" picker fill the output panel, and the preview/edit/source area shrinks to about 17px. It doesn't scroll, so the generated letter can't be read. With a 1300px-tall window it renders fine.

The application detail Documents tab shows the same squeeze on the cover tab. Its document region still scrolls, but the strips take most of the height.

## Cause
- `ai-generate/components/OutputPanelDone/index.tsx` renders `LetterLayoutPicker`, a `flex flex-col` with 6 two-line cards (about 330px or more), as a `shrink-0` block above the preview.
- The preview wrapper (`flex flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden`) is the only flexible child, so it absorbs all the shortfall.
- The same picker sits in the Documents tab's option strips (`GenerationOutput/OutputOptionStrips`).

## Fix
- Lay the picker out as a compact grid, or make it collapsible, and/or cap its height with its own scroll.
- Give the preview a min-height floor so the document is always readable.

title: perf(ai): parallel draft and letter, shared prompt prefix, and a resume-blind analyze cache
body:
Smaller, situational speedups for the résumé pipeline. These come after the reasoning-effort, parallel-research and idle-timeout fixes.

1. **Draft and cover letter in parallel.**
   - The letter reads only `ctx.strategy` (`stages/cover_letter.rs`), not the draft.
   - Both stages share one stream jobId (`stages/draft.rs`), so they need separate stream ids first.
   - Estimated saving: about 6 s on gpt-oss and 15–30 s on Claude Code, but **0 on a single-GPU local Ollama**.
2. **Smaller prompts and a shared prefix.** Per-run input is about 15k tokens.
   - Drop `candidate_resume` from the strategy prompt (`prompts/strategy.rs`). The evidence already carries what it needs.
   - Put résumé + job first as a common prefix, so Ollama and cloud prefix caches can reuse it between draft and letter. Today their system prompts differ from token 0, so nothing is reused.
3. **Résumé-blind analyze cache.**
   - `analyze_job` is résumé-blind by design, but its cache key chains the résumé (`pipeline/resume/mod.rs`). Editing the résumé therefore re-pays 10–30 s.
   - Key it on job, language, routing and effective effort only.
   - Cache hit rate today: 6/34, on exact re-runs only.
4. **Schema trimming.** Several analyze/strategy output fields are discarded or only counted (`redFlags`, `CompanyPlan.title/dates/condensed`). Together that is about 100–200 tokens: roughly 20 s locally, about 1 s on cloud.
